games.name: 🎰 Slots
games.odds: Three of a kind: 🍒 3x · 🍋 5x · 🔔 8x · 🔺 10x · 💎 25x. Any pair returns the bet. Three 💎 also win the **progressive jackpot** (all of it at the max bet, a share of it below). Lose, and **Redeem yourself** spins 15 reels: 7 of a kind (about 9%) wins the bet back. Expected return: 93.2% before the jackpot.

games.name: 🪙 Coinflip
games.odds: A correct call pays 1.95x. Expected return: 97.5%.

games.name: 🎲 Dice
games.odds: Pays 96% of the fair odds for the chosen range. Expected return: 96%.

games.name: 🎡 Roulette
games.odds: Red/black, odd/even, low/high pay 2x; dozens pay 3x; a single number pays 36x. The green 0 is the edge. Expected return: 97.3%.

games.name: 🃏 Blackjack
games.odds: A win pays 2x, a blackjack 2.5x, a tie returns the bet. TODD stands on 17. Expected return: about 99% with good play.

games.name: 🔼 Higher or Lower
games.odds: Each correct guess multiplies by 96% of its fair odds (capped at 100x). Expected return: 96% per guess.

games.name: 💣 Minesweeper
games.odds: Each safe tile multiplies by 96% of its fair odds. Expected return: 96%.

games.name: 🚀 Rocket
games.odds: The chance of reaching a multiplier x is 96% ÷ x (capped at 50x, or 100x in a server that built the Rocket). Expected return: 96%.

buildings.name: Corner Shop
buildings.perkText: a company you pick earns 10% of its rent; +5% rent for each home next door; launders hot loot

buildings.name: Mansion
buildings.perkText: throw a party once a day: chat pay doubles for everyone here for an hour

buildings.name: Lighthouse
buildings.perkText: rarer fish on plain bait, half storm damage to all your buildings, safer smuggling. Built on the edge of the map

buildings.name: Station
buildings.perkText: buildings within 2 tiles earn +10% rent; ship your crops and goods by freight for more

buildings.name: Factory
buildings.perkText: makes 24 crates of Goods a day per level. Pollutes: −15% rent and faster wear next door

buildings.name: Warehouse
buildings.perkText: sell crops at the best price of the last 3 days (5 at level 2, 7 at level 3), and order seeds wholesale with your own daily allowance

buildings.name: Barn
buildings.perkText: unlocks 6 more farm plots (up to 15, in 3 rows of 5)

buildings.name: Bank Branch
buildings.perkText: your savings earn 25% more interest per level

buildings.name: Park
buildings.perkText: no rent, but +15% rent for every building next to it

buildings.name: Police Station
buildings.perkText: the Connector can't set up within 1 tile, and no squatters within 1 tile

landmarks.name: The TODD Statue
landmarks.perk: +5% rent on every building in the server

landmarks.name: The Stadium
landmarks.perk: chat pay ×1.25 for everyone in the server

landmarks.name: The Rocket
landmarks.perk: the Rend-Sino's Rocket can fly to 100x (instead of 50x)

contraband.name: Loaded Dice
contraband.desc: Better odds for your next 5 casino games. TODD might spot them.

contraband.name: Fake ID
contraband.desc: Skip a casino ban (now, or the next time TODD throws you out).

contraband.name: Insider Tip
contraband.desc: Where a stock is heading in the next hour. Usually right.

contraband.name: Rumor Mill
contraband.desc: Nudge a company's price 3% up or down. Once per company a day here.

contraband.name: Smoke Bomb
contraband.desc: Refuse your next buyout bid without paying the fee.

contraband.name: Squatter Crew
contraband.desc: Squatters into someone else's place (under 75%). One a day.

events.name: Labor Shortage
events.desc: Nobody wants to work. Shifts and gigs pay **1.5x**.

events.name: Snow Day
events.desc: The roads are closed. **No work today**, but chat pay is **doubled**. Go build a snowman.

events.name: Rain
events.desc: Rain over every farm. Crops are **watered for free** while it lasts.

events.name: Storm
events.desc: A storm rolls in. Crops outside a **Greenhouse** can be flattened.

events.name: Fish Frenzy
events.desc: The fish are biting. Cast every **90 seconds**, and plain bait works like a lure.

events.name: Police Strike
events.desc: TODD's security team walked out. Heists get **+15%** odds.

events.name: Bear Rumors
events.desc: Everyone smells a drop. Shorts open with **no fee**.

events.name: Gossip Hour
events.desc: Chat pay is **doubled**, and so is the daily cap.

events.name: Hiring Spree
events.desc: **a company** is hiring heavily. Its shifts pay **2x**.

events.name: Fire Sale
events.desc: **a company** is sliding. Shorts on it open with **no fee**.

events.name: Happy Hour
events.desc: The Rend-Sino is buzzing. The progressive jackpot grows **3x** as fast, VIPs get a **second free spin**, and TODD looks the other way on hot streaks.
